chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he asked him:
About the skin of a dead animal being worn in salat (prayer) if it has been tanned, he said: "No, even if it has been tanned seventy times."

key_terms.الْمَيْتَةِ: a dead animal not lawfully slaughtered; carrion

ai.seo_question: Can the tanned skin of a dead animal be worn during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the skin of carrion may not be worn in salat (prayer), even after tanning. It indicates that tanning does not render the hide of a dead animal permissible for ritual use in prayer.
